title: The queue lists features above open fixes
what: Every open fix comes before every open feature in the queue's order, whatever their ip; ip orders items within a kind. The order is derived from the kind when reading, not kept up by hand-picked ip numbers.
why: rules/queue.md: "A new fix goes above every open feature"; principle 1: a found defect is a fix item above the features. Seen 26 Oct: `relay queue count` names a feature as the top ("one-digest-per-wave-instead-of-status-messages (feature, ip 95)") while 39 fixes are open; 21 open features have an ip above the lowest open fix (ip 60), most of them ips the front chose itself.
failing_case: `relay queue count` on 26 Oct: "39 fix, 37 feature; top: one-digest-per-wave-instead-of-status-messages (feature, ip 95, 1h)".
pass_cases: With a fix at ip 60 and a feature at ip 95 open, the queue lists the fix first and count's top is the fix; two fixes keep their ip order.
where: lib/relay_queue.py the order of `relay queue`, `relay queue count` (its "top") and whatever picks the next item
